01105:                                 context,

01107:                                 Toast.LENGTH_SHORT
01108:                             ).show()
01109:                         }
01110:
01111:                         try {
01112:                             session.outputStream?.close()
01113:                         } catch (_: Exception) {}
01114:                         session.outputStream = null
01115:
01116:                         deleteLocalDownloadFileIfExists(context, targetName)
01117:                         delay(2000)
01118:                     }
01119:                 }
01120:             }
01121:

01123:                 activeDownloads.remove(item.path)
01124:                 _activeTransfers.value = _activeTransfers.value.filter { it.filePath != item.path }
01125:                 try {
01126:                     session.outputStream?.close()
01127:                 } catch (_: Exception) {}
01128:                 deleteLocalDownloadFileIfExists(context, targetName)
01129:             }
01130:         }

01133:     fun cancelCopyMove(targetFilePath: String? = null) {
01134:         try {
01135:             val key = targetFilePath ?: activeCopyMoveSessions.keys.firstOrNull()
01136:             val session = if (key != null) activeCopyMoveSessions.remove(key) else null
01137:
01138:             val name = session?.fileName ?: "archivo"
01139:             session?.job?.cancel()
01140:
01141:             if (copyingDestPath == key) {
01142:                 try {
01143:                     copyingFileOutputStream?.flush()
01144:                     copyingFileOutputStream?.close()
01145:                 } catch (_: Exception) {}
01146:                 copyingFileOutputStream = null
01147:                 copyingTempFile?.delete()
01148:                 copyingTempFile = null
01149:                 copyingSourcePath = null
01150:                 copyingDestPath = null
01151:             }
01152:
01153:             _activeTransfers.value = _activeTransfers.value.filter { it.filePath != key }
01154:
01155:             val label = if (session?.isMove == true) "Movimiento cancelado" else "Copia cancelada"
01156:             _statusMessage.value = "$label: $name"
01157:         } catch (e: Exception) {
01158:             Log.e("MeshFilesCopy", "Error canceling copy/move: ${e.localizedMessage}", e)
01159:         }
01160:     }
01161:
01162:     fun cancelTransfer(filePath: String) {
01163:         if (activeZipSessions.containsKey(filePath)) {
01164:             cancelZip(filePath)
01165:         } else if (activeCopyMoveSessions.containsKey(filePath)) {
01166:             cancelCopyMove(filePath)
01167:         } else if (activeDownloads.containsKey(filePath)) {
01168:             cancelDownload(filePath)
01169:         } else if (activeUploads.containsKey(filePath)) {
01170:             cancelUpload(filePath)
01171:         } else {
01172:             cancelZip(filePath)
01173:             cancelCopyMove(filePath)
01174:             cancelDownload(filePath)
01175:             cancelUpload(filePath)
01176:         }
01177:     }
01178:
01179:     fun cancelDownload(targetFilePath: String? = null) {
01180:         try {
01181:             val key = targetFilePath ?: activeDownloads.keys.firstOrNull()
01182:             val session = if (key != null) activeDownloads.remove(key) else null
01183:
01184:             val name = session?.fileName ?: "archivo"
01185:             val ctx = session?.context
01186:
01187:             session?.downloadJob?.cancel()
01188:
01189:             try {
01190:                 session?.outputStream?.flush()
01191:                 session?.outputStream?.close()
01192:             } catch (_: Exception) {}
01193:
01194:             if (session != null) {
01195:                 if (ctx != null) {
01196:                     deleteLocalDownloadFileIfExists(ctx, session.fileName)
01197:                 } else {
01198:                     val downloadsDir = Environment.getExternalStoragePublicDirectory(Environment.DIRECTORY_DOWNLOADS)
01199:                     val destFile = File(downloadsDir, session.fileName)
01200:                     if (destFile.exists()) {
01201:                         destFile.delete()
01202:                     }
01203:                 }
01204:
01205:                 val notificationManager = ctx?.getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE) as? NotificationManager
01206:                 notificationManager?.cancel(session.filePath.hashCode())
01207:             }
01208:
01209:             _activeTransfers.value = _activeTransfers.value.filter { it.filePath != key }
01210:
01211:             if (ctx != null) {
01212:                 scope.launch(Dispatchers.Main) {
01213:                     Toast.makeText(ctx, ctx.getString(R.string.download_canceled, name), Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
01214:                 }
01215:             }
01216:         } catch (e: Exception) {
01217:             Log.e("MeshFilesDownload", "Error canceling download: ${e.localizedMessage}", e)
01218:         }
01219:     }

01250:     private fun ensureNotificationChannel(context: Context) {
01251:         if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
01252:             val notificationManager = context.getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE) as? NotificationManager ?: return
01253:             val channel = NotificationChannel(
01254:                 "file_downloads",
01255:                 context.getString(R.string.notification_downloads_uploads_channel),
01256:                 NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_LOW
01257:             ).apply {
01258:                 description = context.getString(R.string.notification_downloads_uploads_desc)
01259:                 setShowBadge(true)
01260:             }
01261:             notificationManager.createNotificationChannel(channel)
01262:         }
01263:     }
01264:
01265:     private fun updateDownloadNotification(
01266:         context: Context,
01267:         fileName: String,
01268:         filePath: String,
01269:         received: Long,
01270:         total: Long
01271:     ) {
01272:         val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
01273:         if (now - lastProgressNotificationTime < 250 && received < total && received > 0) return
01274:         lastProgressNotificationTime = now
01275:
01276:         try {
01277:             ensureNotificationChannel(context)
01278:             val notificationManager = context.getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE) as? NotificationManager ?: return
01279:
01280:             val notificationId = filePath.hashCode()
01281:             val progressPercent = if (total > 0) ((received * 100) / total).toInt().coerceIn(0, 100) else 0
01282:
01283:             val cancelIntent = Intent(context, DownloadCancelReceiver::class.java).apply {
01284:                 action = "ACTION_CANCEL_TRANSFER"
01285:                 putExtra("FILE_PATH", filePath)
01286:             }
01287:             val pendingIntent = PendingIntent.getBroadcast(
01288:                 context,
01289:                 filePath.hashCode(),
01290:                 cancelIntent,
01291:                 PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT or PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE
01292:             )
01293:
01294:             val builder = NotificationCompat.Builder(context, "file_downloads")
01295:                 .setSmallIcon(android.R.drawable.stat_sys_download)
01296:                 .setContentTitle("Descargando $fileName")
01297:                 .setContentText("${formatSize(received)} / ${formatSize(total)} ($progressPercent%)")
01298:                 .setProgress(100, progressPercent, total <= 0)
01299:                 .setOngoing(true)
01300:                 .setOnlyAlertOnce(true)
01301:                 .setPriority(NotificationCompat.PRIORITY_LOW)
01302:                 .addAction(
01303:                     android.R.drawable.ic_menu_close_clear_cancel,
01304:                     "Cancelar",
01305:                     pendingIntent
01306:                 )
01307:
01308:             notificationManager.notify(notificationId, builder.build())
01309:         } catch (e: Exception) {
01310:             Log.e("MeshFilesDownload", "Error showing progress notification: ${e.localizedMessage}", e)
01311:         }
01312:     }
